newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Dollar/yen vols dive on spot rebound.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Dollar/yen vols dive on spot rebound.

text.p: Implied volatilities on dollar/yen options plunged nearly two percentage points in Europe after spot shot up around two yen from the previous close here.
One-month vol, which had soared two points to above 14 percent on Tuesday after spot's two-yen collapse to around 113 yen, retreated to 12.55/12.7 percent as spot recovered to near 116.
"As opinion grows that the dollar has based for the time being, we see vols coming lower in the front end," said an options dealer at a U.S. bank in London.
Dollar/yen vols eased farther along the vol curve too.
Six-month vol fell to 10.65/10.9 percent by 1105 GMT from late Wednesday's European level of 11.4/11.9, while one-year was quoted at 10.55/10.75 percent versus 11.2/11.4.
Risk reversals continued to favour yen calls, however, with one-month quoted at 0.95/1.25 percent versus 1.0/1.4 yesterday.
Dollar/mark vol also eased, though levels remain clearly lower than for dollar/yen as spot puts in a steadier performance.
One-month dollar/mark vol softened to 9.25/9.55 percent from 9.9/10.15 percent in late Europe on Wednesday.
Risk reversals favoured mark calls, but by a slim margin of 0.05/0.35 percent. That compared with the more pronounced skew of 0.3/0.5 percent for mark calls yesterday.
The mark/yen cross also saw volatilities decline as spot climbed.
One-month mark/yen vol stood at 11.1/11.8 percent versus late yesterday's 12.1/12.5, with risk reversals biased towards mark puts though to a slightly less extreme degree than yesterday.
